title: The frozen cases T1-T7, re-created for spec v2
spec: Spec v2 (builder/spec/game-spec.v2.schema.json, contracts step 1 of 2026-10-13): no engine field. foundation.at gives the JSON pointer of each answer in the locked spec; foundation.accept lists the values a judge accepts, and why. A value outside it is not refused by the loop (the catalog never gates an idea); it fails this case's foundation item unless the second reader finds the ledger's reason sound, which the record states.

how.gate:<A-F>: that gate's verdict on the delivered game
how.release: the kit's own release tests (a game breaks them only by breaking a kit-owned thing)
how.probe:<name>: evals/probes/<name>.mjs on the run (not all written yet; an unwritten probe is recorded as not run)
how.judge: the second reader, from the witness bundle

budget: None: cost never stops a build (the creator, 2026-10-13). Time, tokens and money are recorded.
history: The cases as first frozen (with an engine field and numbered checks) stay in games.fun research/studio-v2/evals/cases/ as history. They are not run on xgames-kit and nothing converts them (no backwards compatibility, the creator, 2026-10-13).
